requirement.original: Redesign the currency system in the travel-planner project. Systematic architecture fix with 10 sub-tasks.
requirement.clarified: Replace the fragmented dual-direction currency model (fallback_exchange_rate CNY→EUR + cross_rates_to_cny foreign→CNY + 'in USD' agent prompts) with a unified single-direction model: default_currency=EUR, exchange_rates map (1 EUR = X local), currency_local at plan level and optional day level. Simplify HTML generator conversion to direct division. Update all agent prompts to reference currency_local. Add currency validation to save.py and plan-validate.py. Fix requirements-skeleton.json and update schemas.
requirement.why: Three incompatible currency surfaces (agents say USD, config stores EUR/CNY inverted rate, data files write CNY) cause incorrect budget display and LLM agents producing wrong currency values

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Agents produce USD-denominated costs, but data files store CNY, and config converts CNY→EUR via inverted rate (fallback_exchange_rate=0.128 means 1 CNY = 0.128 EUR), causing triple-mismatch: instruction currency, storage currency, display currency are all different
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The currency config was created (commit 3d5971b, 2026-02-03) without a comprehensive data model — `fallback_exchange_rate` was a CNY-to-display scalar, not a currency map. Agent prompts inherited USD from early LLM defaults, never updated when the project moved to CNY-first data. No central currency_local authority existed at plan or day level, so each agent independently interpreted currency requirements.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 3d5971b — checkpoint 2026-02-03 (first creation of currency-config.json with only fallback_exchange_rate, no cross_rates_to_cny; cross_rates_to_cny added later without removing original field)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Initial config designed as a quick display-formatting helper (1 number to convert CNY totals to EUR for display). Agent prompts were never centrally updated; USD remained as the LLM's default 'international' currency assumption.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Three independent patches (cb6cc4d: data values, f1e0325: HTML rendering, a403e6b: schema normalization) treated symptoms without addressing the model: agent prompts still instruct USD, config still stores CNY-centric inverse rate, no plan-level currency_local authority.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: 2026-02-03: config created (CNY-centric). 2026-02-09/10: USD→CNY data patches. 2026-03-05: config last_updated but model unchanged. 2026-04-18: full redesign.
